name: GSD Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: GSD Technologies Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the production and global distribution of environmental protection equipment and related consumables, with operations spanning Asia and international markets. Their extensive product line includes both submersible and land-based pumps, blowers, a variety of machinery series, oxygen aeration systems, mixing and flow propulsion units, solid-liquid separation devices, and integrated compact systems, among other specialized offerings. In addition to manufacturing, the company provides a full suite of services, such as equipment installation and maintenance, expert environmental technology consulting, engineering design, and essential repair and technical support. Founded in 2013, GSD Technologies maintains its principal headquarters in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.
